basic_details.job_title: CSIR AMPRI Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online for Project Assistant II, Project Associate and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: CSIR Advanced Materials and Processes Research Institute (CSIR AMPRI) is recruiting candidates for 8 contractual vacancies for Project Associate-II (PAT-II), Project Associate-I (PAT-I), Project Assistant-II, and Senior Project Associate (Senior PAT) posts under advertisement number PROJ-07/2026. Qualification requirements vary by post. Eligible candidates can apply online from 14 October 2026 to 28 October 2026. Applicants must take a printout of the application form and appear for the walk-in interview at CSIR-AMPRI, Bhopal on the scheduled date with documents, with interviews held on 29 Oct

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Monthly emoluments vary depending on the post and candidate qualifications: Post Code - 01 (Project Associate-II): Rs. 35,000/- + HRA for candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE or National level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments like DBT/DST or equivalent; Rs. 28,000/- + HRA for others. Project duration is up to 31.03.2031. Post Code - 02 (Project Associate-I): Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for candidates who qualified CSIR-UGC/ICAR/ICMR NET including lectureship/assistant professorship or GATE or Central Government national level examinations; Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others. Project duration is up to 31.03.2031. Post Code - 03 (Project Assistant-II): Rs. 20,000/- + HRA with an increment of 15% after 3 years of experience in the same project. Project duration is up to 31.03.2031. Post Code - 04 (Senior Project Associate): ₹ 42,000/- + HRA. Project duration is up to 31.03.2028. Post Code - 05 (Project Associate-I): Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE/equivalent national exam qualified candidates; Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others. Project duration is up to 31.03.2031. Post Code - 06 (Project Associate-I): Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE/equivalent qualified candidates; Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others. Project duration is up to 31.03.2028. Post Code - 07 (Project Associate-I): Rs. 31,000/- + HRA for NET/GATE/equivalent qualified candidates; Rs. 25,000/- + HRA for others. Project duration is up to 31.10.2030.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CSIR AMPRI Project Associate
content_sections.text: Visit the official website at www.ampri.res.in. Access the online application portal available from 14.10.2026 to 28.10.2026. Fill out the online application form with required details for the desired post code. Submit the application successfully before the last date of 28.10.2026. Take a printout of the submitted application form and bring it along with a set of copies of all mentioned documents, testimonials, certificates, and original documents for verification at the walk-in interview.

content_sections.heading: Selection and Interview
content_sections.text: The selection process is based on a walk-in model combined with document verification. Candidates who have submitted online applications and meet eligibility criteria must report for the walk-in interview at CSIR-AMPRI, Bhopal according to the schedule. Document verification takes place on the interview day prior to the interview. Eligible candidates proceed to the interview immediately after verification. Walk-in Interview Schedule: Post Code - 01, 02, 03: 29.10.2026 (Reporting Time: 09:00 AM – 10:00 AM) Post Code - 04, 05: 29.10.2026 (Reporting Time: 01:00 PM – 02:00 PM) Post Code - 06: 30.10.2026 (Reporting Time: 09:00 AM – 10:00 AM) Post Code - 07: 30.10.2026 (Reporting Time: 01:00 PM – 02:00 PM)

faq.question: Q1. Are these posts permanent or temporary?
faq.answer: These positions are purely temporary and contractual, co-terminus with the duration of the respective sponsored or consultancy projects.

faq.question: Q2. What is the upper age limit and relaxation applicable?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years for Post Codes 01, 02, 03, 05, 06, and 07, and 40 years for Post Code 04. Age relaxation is 05 years for SC/ST/PwBD/Women and 03 years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date to submit online applications through the portal is 28 October 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What documents are required for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates must bring the downloaded copy of the application form, one set of photocopies of all mentioned documents, testimonials, and certificates, along with the original documents for verification.

faq.question: Q5. Can a candidate apply for more than one post code?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate may apply for multiple advertised posts by submitting separate applications for each post code.
